exposure: new delivery room protocol involving mobile resuscitation equipment (LifeStart™)
outcome: transfers to Neonatal Intensive Care Unit
cohort: Participants were term and near-term infants delivered via assisted vaginal delivery.
finding: The new delivery-room protocol involving mobile resuscitation equipment significantly reduced the overall prevalence of early cord clamping from 13% to 1% and increased mean cord clamping time by 43%.
mod_finding: The new delivery-room protocol successfully eliminated early cord clamping in assisted vaginal deliveries of term and near-term infants.
